Pricing.//: Escape hatch: true reproduces the legacy ceil-to-1dp formula and ignores rules.

Observability.//: Phase 6 system statistics: collector cadence, sample retention and alert evaluation.

Notifications.//: Inbox-row retention. The NotificationRecord audit trail is never purged.

BusinessAnalytics.//: Admin business-KPI windows. Deliberately separate from Telemetry: telemetry's 92-day cap is tuned for request forensics, not year-long growth reporting.

Telemetry.//: Request telemetry is best-effort: bounded buffer, drop-oldest, sampled raw log. Rollups are exact.

Quotas.//: Safe rollout: enforcement is opt-in. A limit of 0 means 'not configured' -> unlimited.

Conversations.//: S7: a bound conversation attachment past this window is deleted, remote asset first.

Media.//: Where image bytes live. 'database' is the safe default; Production must set 'cloudinary' or opt in via AllowDatabaseProviderInProduction.
Media.//DualWrite: Off by default: keeping every byte in the database defeats the migration.
Media.//SigningKey: base64, 32 bytes. Required when Provider=cloudinary; inject it, never commit it.
Media.//PublicBaseUrl: Absolute origin used to build the token URLs handed to external fetchers.
Media.//ImageUrlAllowlist: Comma-separated host names; empty means any public host.
Media.//CatalogMaxFileBytes: 2 MB: the catalog tier's own cap, tighter than the 5 MB attachment cap.
Media.//CatalogDisplayWidth: Exactly one delivery width; never add a second (strategy 3.7).

Cloudinary.//: Non-secret settings only. CloudName/ApiKey/ApiSecret are resolved from CLOUDINARY_URL (or the discrete CLOUDINARY_* variables), never from this committed file.
